name: Thumba
description: A self-hosted Thumbnail generator/finder which creates thumbnails based on folder names and google search results. This project uses the Google search api to find URL-s based on folder names. From there thum.io is used to generat thumbnails of the url-s. Check the readme https://github.com/BoKKeR/thumba

variables.name: GOOGLE_SEARCH_KEY
variables.description: Google custom search key: Check the readme https://github.com/BoKKeR/thumba

variables.name: GOOGLE_SEARCH_CX
variables.description: Google custom search project id: Check the readme https://github.com/BoKKeR/thumba

variables.name: THUM_KEY_ID
variables.description: Thum.io keyID: Check the readme https://github.com/BoKKeR/thumba

variables.name: THUM_KEY_SECRET
variables.description: Thum.io keySecret: Check the readme https://github.com/BoKKeR/thumba

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_HOST
variables.description: Set the host IP/domain without port
